department: School of Biomedical and Chemical Engineering

deadline.value: Materials for full consideration for funding are due December 15 for Fall (M.S. and PhD). No year is given, so the 2026/27 cycle is used.

also.quote: For full consideration for funding, application materials must be received by the following dates.

gre_general.value: The school says GRE scores are no longer required.
gre_general.quote: GRE scores are no longer required.

gre_subject.value: No GRE, including a subject test, is required.
gre_subject.quote: GRE scores are no longer required.

supervisor.value: Students rotate through labs for a year before matching with an advisor, and faculty should not be asked to review applications in advance.
supervisor.quote: A one-year opportunity for students to rotate through research labs

also.quote: Please do not request that faculty members review your qualifications before applying

funding.value: Most PhD students have full funding (tuition and a stipend) from the school or a faculty member's lab.
funding.quote: Most of our Ph.D. students and many of our M.S. students have full funding (including tuition and a monthly stipend) from the School or a specific core faculty member and their lab.

entry_route.value: Competitive applicants hold an undergraduate degree in chemical, biological, biomedical engineering or a closely related field; no master's is stated as required.
entry_route.quote: An undergraduate degree in chemical, biological, or biomedical engineering or a closely related engineering or science discipline.

toefl_min.value: The school's unconditional TOEFL minimum is 80 internet-based, which conflicts with the Graduate School's 4.5 from January 2026.
toefl_min.quote: The minimum TOEFL score for admission without condition is 550 (paper -based), or 80 (internet-based).

ielts_min.value: The school's unconditional IELTS minimum is 6.5, the same as the Graduate School.
ielts_min.quote: The minimum IELTS score for admission without condition is 6.5.

notes: Shared school rules for bioengineering and chemical engineering, as on the Chemical Engineering record. Lab rotations are funded as research assistantships for top PhD candidates.
name: Bioengineering (Ph.D.)
